title: v2 Page
description: A single page within a v2 multi-page QR code. IMPORTANT — this models the real clean_page shape built in QRCodeSerializer.validate (qr_manager/serializers.py), not the builder's in-memory page shape: component/audio/image/document/intro pages carry their content in the top-level `blocks` array (structurally validated per exact page type via page-types/<type>-page.json, which also dispatches each block's `data` by block type — intro's own enum is deliberately narrow, see page-types/intro-page.json); ai pages carry their content in `data.html` (+ optional `data.ai_session_id`, since a page can be AI-generated once and never refined again) and always have an empty-or-absent-content `blocks` array. `blocks` is never nested under `data` in the real published shape — a prior version of this file modeled `data.blocks` and was consequently never usable to validate a real clean_page (see schema_validator.py history / test_page_security.py's ValidateV2EnvelopeSecuritySchemaTests docstring).

blocks.description: Structurally validated per exact page type below; component/audio/image/document/intro pages route through page-types/<type>-page.json, ai pages are left unconstrained here (their real content lives in `data`, and Stage-1's historical blank-page guard has always skipped ai-typed pages).

data.description: Only meaningful for ai-typed pages (data.html + optional data.ai_session_id, see page-types/ai-page.json). Absent for component/audio/image/document/intro pages, whose content lives in `blocks` instead.

security.description: Per-page access-control gates. Absent or empty means the page has no gate. Adding a new gate type means adding one more property here.
